overview_description.description: Million-2-1 is established as the UK's leading service provider for SMS prize competitions, lotteries and mobile marketing. As part of the IGT-UK Group Million-2-1 now also brings the world's best known gaming brands to the mobile and online platforms. They specialise in highly engaging, innovative solutions that tap into the power of the mobile channel and redefine relationships between a brand and customer.
